notes.title: Harness the power of the elements and mix them to win in Elemental Brawl!
notes.content:
Mayor Games is proud to announce that our next game, Elemental Brawl, is going to launch later this year with the help of the awesome folks from indie.io.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1075880/Elemental_Brawl/]
Check our Steam page [/url]for lots of info, screenshots and to wishlist our game (it helps us A LOT!), so you get updates as soon as we have them!

After you do that, check out below to know more about Elemental Brawl and the awesome teams making it happen:


[h1]What is Elemental Brawl?[/h1]

Elemental Brawl is a local and online party game with platform fighter mechanics where you harness the power of the elements and combine them to win. You play in rounds with different modes and objectives each, until a player gets enough points to achieve victory!
We’re having lots of fun playing and making the game, and hope you will too soon!


[h1]What inspired you to make Elemental Brawl?[/h1]

When we started developing the game a bit over 2 years ago, we wanted to make a game that players of different skills levels could enjoy together and have a chaotic good time. We were inspired by games like Kirby 64 with its ability absorption and combining mechanic, Smash Bros with its easy to play / hard to master combat, and party games like Fall Guys with its variety of mini games with similar control schemes.

Our mission is to make a game that you and your friends play whenever you want to have a good time together, having big laughs and competing in a fun light-hearted way.


[h1]Who is Mayor Games?[/h1]

We’re a small indie studio located in Curitiba, a city in southern Brazil. Our team is comprised of people of diverse backgrounds, but with the common love of making games that more competitive gamers can play not only with other competitive players, but also with their more casual gamer friends (or even people that don’t even call themselves gamers).


[h1]Who is indie.io? Why are you partnering with them?[/h1]

While game design, art, coding and sound are huge parts of game creation, there are many other areas that are crucial in order to make a great game: playtesting, quality assurance, porting, adapting the game to other regions and languages, marketing, and so on…

All of these areas take a lot of time, talent and effort to develop, and we decided that in order to make Elemental Brawl the best game we can, we should focus on the areas we are more talented at, and partner with a publisher that could help in the other areas.

This is where indie.io shines! We analyzed not only their work as a publisher, but also what other developers that worked with them had to say, and soon enough we were sure they were the right partners for us. Their work and expertise will help us make Elemental Brawl a better, more polished game, and to reach more players worldwide.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio]Make sure to check all the other amazing games also being published by indie.io here![/url]


[h1]That’s cool! When is the game releasing?[/h1]

We’re not ready to announce a specific release date yet, but wishlist our game and you’ll be notified whenever we announce it or any other relevant information, like the opening of our public Discord server.

Make sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1075880/Elemental_Brawl/]wishlist our game[/url] and share it with the friends you think will enjoy Elemental Brawl as well!

See you in the arena soon!
